title: SPI Master (Mode 0)
constraints: SPI mode 0 (CPOL = 0, CPHA = 0), MSB first, one full-duplex byte per transfer. `sclk` runs at clk/4. All outputs are registered.

Idle: `cs_n = 1`, `sclk = 0`, `mosi = 0`, `busy = 0`. An edge with `start` while idle: `cs_n <= 0`, `busy <= 1`, `mosi <= tx_data[7]`, and a cycle counter c starts at 0 (it counts the edges since start).

When the counter reaches c % 4 == 2: `sclk <= 1` and sample `miso` (shift it into the receive register). When it reaches c % 4 == 0 (c > 0): `sclk <= 0`, and if c < 32, `mosi <=` the next bit. At c == 32: `cs_n <= 1`, `busy <= 0`, `mosi <= 0`, `done <= 1` for one cycle, and `rx_data <=` the 8 received bits.
`start` while busy is ignored. Synchronous reset → idle, `rx_data = 0`.
hints: A 6-bit counter c and two shift registers (tx and rx) are all the state you need.
In mode 0 both sides change data on the falling edge of sclk and sample on the rising edge. The slave shifts its next bit out after each sclk falling edge.
Write the counter as the edge count after the update: compute `cn = c + 1` and decide on `cn % 4`.

examples.title: exchange
examples.expected: mosi carries A5, rx_data = 0x3C after 32 cycles
